definitions.explanation: An unbroken, continuous line used in diagrams, maps, drawings, road markings, and technical documents. Contrasted with a broken or dashed line.

examples.japanese: {実線|じっせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧。
examples.english: To enclose with a solid line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{実線|じっせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{車線|しゃせん}{変更|へんこう}→車線変更：17361_shasenhenkou⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: A white solid line on the road indicates that lane changing is prohibited.

examples.japanese: ⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{実線|じっせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{破線|はせん}→破線：20764_hasen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}している→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
examples.english: In the graph, the solid line represents actual results and the dashed line represents projections.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧ (solid, actual) and ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line). Note this is a homophone of ⟦{実戦|じっせん}→実戦：12306_jissen⟧ (actual combat) and ⟦{実践|じっせん}→実践：08241_jissen⟧ (practice, implementation), but the meaning is entirely different.

USAGE:
Used in technical drawing, graphic design, road markings, maps, and chart/graph descriptions. On Japanese roads, crossing a {実線|じっせん} (solid line) is generally prohibited, while crossing a ⟦{破線|はせん}→破線：20764_hasen⟧ (dashed line) may be permitted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実線|じっせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧ — to draw with a solid line
- {実線|じっせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧ — to enclose with a solid line
- ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{実線|じっせん} — white solid line (road marking)
- {実線|じっせん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{破線|はせん}→破線：20764_hasen⟧ — solid line and dashed line

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{破線|はせん}→破線：20764_hasen⟧ — dashed line, broken line; the contrasting line type
- ⟦{点線|てんせん}→点線：18308_tensen⟧ — dotted line; a line made of dots
- ⟦{二重線|にじゅうせん}→二重線：10288_nijuusen⟧ — double line; two parallel lines
